```{r setup, include = FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(flextable)
library(openxlsx)

dashboard <- read_csv("data/ca_dashboard.csv") %>% 
  filter(countyname == "Solano" |
           rtype == "X") %>% 
  mutate(statuslevel = as_factor(statuslevel),
         reportingyear = fct_relevel(as_factor(reportingyear), "2019"),
         indicator = as_factor(indicator), 
         studentgroup = as_factor(studentgroup),
         student_group_long = fct_relevel(as_factor(student_group_long),
                                    "All students",
                                    "American Indian or Alaska Native",
                                    "Asian",
                                    "Black/African American",
                                    "Filipino",
                                    "Hispanic",
                                    "Pacific Islander",
                                    "White",
                                    "Multiple Races/Two or more",
                                    "Socioeconomically Disadvantaged",
                                    "Homeless Youth",
                                    "Students with Disabilities",
                                    "Foster Youth",
                                    "English Learner",
                                    "Long-Term English Learner",
                                    "English Learners Only",
                                    "RFEPs Only",
                                    "English Only",
                                    "Smarter Balanced Assessment",
                                    "CA Alternative Assessment"
                                    ),
         charter_flag = if_else(is.na(charter_flag), "N", charter_flag),
         color = as_factor(case_match(color,
                                      0 ~ "No color",
                                      1 ~ "Red",
                                      2 ~ "Orange",
                                      3 ~ "Yellow",
                                      4 ~ "Green",
                                      5 ~ "Blue")),
         lea = if_else(charter_flag == "Y", schoolname, districtname)) 

status_colors <- c(
  "lightgrey", "tomato", "orange",
  "yellow", "mediumseagreen", "dodgerblue", "darkgrey"
)

charter_performance <- read.xlsx("data/charter_perfcat25.xlsx", sheet = 1, startRow = 4)
charter_info <- read_csv("data/charter_info.csv")
```

## Charter Performance

```{r charter_summary}
#| echo: false

charter_summary <- 
  charter_performance %>% 
  filter(County == "Solano") %>% 
  select(-CDS) %>% 
  left_join(charter_info, by = join_by("School" == "Charter School", District, County)) %>% 
  select(CDS, County, District, School, `Funding Model`, Performance_Level, Criteria, `Date Charter Expires`)

```

```{r dashboard_summary}
#| echo: false

exclude_groups <- c("Asian", "Filipino", "White", "Multiple Races/Two or more", 
                    "Smarter Balanced Assessment")
academic_indicators <- c("ELA", "Math", "ELPI", "college/career")

dashboard_summary <- 
  dashboard %>% 
  filter(reportingyear %in% c("2024", "2023"),
         (countyname == "Solano" & charter_flag == "Y" ) |
          (rtype == "X" ),
         indicator %in% academic_indicators,
         !(student_group_long %in% exclude_groups),
         color != "No color") %>% 
  select(reportingyear, schoolname, indicator, student_group_long, currstatus)

ca_status <- 
  dashboard_summary %>% 
  filter(schoolname == "State of California") %>% 
  rename(ca_status = currstatus) %>% 
  select(-schoolname)

solano_status <- 
  dashboard_summary %>% 
  filter(schoolname != "State of California") %>% 
  left_join(ca_status, by = join_by(reportingyear, indicator, student_group_long))

solano_groups_total <- 
  solano_status %>% 
  group_by(schoolname, indicator) %>% 
  summarise(total_groups = n())

solano_groups_ca_compare_count <- 
  solano_status %>% 
  mutate(compare_ca = case_when(
    currstatus < ca_status ~ "Below",
    currstatus == ca_status ~ "Equal",
    currstatus > ca_status ~ "Above")) %>% 
  group_by(schoolname, indicator, compare_ca) %>% 
  count() %>% 
  left_join(solano_groups_total, by = join_by(schoolname, indicator))

solano_indicators <- 
  charter_summary %>%
  select(School, Performance_Level, Criteria) %>% 
  left_join(solano_status, by = join_by(School == schoolname)) %>% 
  left_join(solano_groups_ca_compare_count, 
            by = join_by(School == schoolname, indicator)) %>% 
  select(School, Performance_Level, Criteria, indicator, total_groups,
         compare_ca, n, reportingyear, student_group_long, ca_status, currstatus) %>% 
  filter((compare_ca == "Below" & currstatus < ca_status) |
         (compare_ca == "Equal" & currstatus == ca_status) |
         (compare_ca == "Above" & currstatus > ca_status)) %>%    
  arrange(School, indicator, compare_ca, reportingyear, student_group_long)
```

```{r write_excel}

# Filter data
filtered_charter <- 
  charter_performance %>% 
  filter(County == "Solano")

filtered_dashboard <- 
  dashboard %>% 
  filter(reportingyear %in% c("2024", "2023"),
         (countyname == "Solano" & charter_flag == "Y" ) |
          (rtype == "X" ))

# Add row indices to the dataset before any grouping operations
solano_indicators <- solano_indicators %>%
  mutate(row_idx = row_number())

# Get merge ranges for hierarchical levels
get_merge_ranges <- function(data, group_vars) {
  data %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(group_vars))) %>%
    summarise(start_row = min(row_idx) + 1,  # +1 for header row
              end_row = max(row_idx) + 1,
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(start_row < end_row)  # Only include groups that need merging (more than 1 row)
}

# Calculate all merge ranges at different hierarchy levels
merge_school <- get_merge_ranges(solano_indicators, c("School"))
merge_perf <- get_merge_ranges(solano_indicators, c("School", "Performance_Level"))
merge_criteria <- get_merge_ranges(solano_indicators, c("School", "Performance_Level", "Criteria"))
merge_indicator <- get_merge_ranges(solano_indicators, c("School", "Performance_Level", "Criteria", "indicator"))
merge_groups <- get_merge_ranges(solano_indicators, c("School", "Performance_Level", "Criteria", "indicator", "total_groups"))
merge_compare <- get_merge_ranges(solano_indicators, c("School", "Performance_Level", "Criteria", "indicator", "total_groups", "compare_ca"))
merge_n <- get_merge_ranges(solano_indicators, c("School", "Performance_Level", "Criteria", "indicator", "total_groups", "compare_ca", "n"))
merge_year <- get_merge_ranges(solano_indicators, c("School", "Performance_Level", "Criteria", "indicator", "total_groups", "compare_ca", "n", "reportingyear"))

# Create Excel Workbook
wb <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wb, "Charter Summary")
addWorksheet(wb, "Dashboard summary (Merged)")
addWorksheet(wb, "Dashboard summary (Unmerged)")
addWorksheet(wb, "Charter Performance ORIGINAL")
addWorksheet(wb, "CA Dashboard (Charters)")

# Add custom style for merged cells
headerStyle <- createStyle(
  fontColour = "#FFFFFF", fgFill = "#4F81BD", 
  halign = "center", valign = "center", 
  textDecoration = "bold", border = "TopBottomLeftRight"
)

# Write data - remove row_idx column before writing
writeData(wb, "Charter Summary", charter_summary)
writeData(wb, "Dashboard summary (Merged)", select(solano_indicators, -row_idx))
writeData(wb, "Dashboard summary (Unmerged)", select(solano_indicators, -row_idx))
writeData(wb, "Charter Performance ORIGINAL", filtered_charter)
writeData(wb, "CA Dashboard (Charters)", filtered_dashboard)

# Apply styles to header row
addStyle(wb, "Dashboard summary (Merged)", headerStyle, rows = 1, cols = 1:(ncol(solano_indicators)-1))

# Function to apply merges for a specific column
apply_column_merges <- function(wb, sheet, merge_data, column_name, data) {
  col_index <- which(names(data) == column_name)
  if(length(col_index) == 1 && nrow(merge_data) > 0) {
    for(i in 1:nrow(merge_data)) {
      mergeCells(wb, sheet, 
                 cols = col_index, 
                 rows = merge_data$start_row[i]:merge_data$end_row[i])
    }
  }
}

# Apply merges for each column based on their respective hierarchical level
apply_column_merges(wb, "Dashboard summary (Merged)", merge_school, "School", solano_indicators)
apply_column_merges(wb, "Dashboard summary (Merged)", merge_perf, "Performance_Level", solano_indicators)
apply_column_merges(wb, "Dashboard summary (Merged)", merge_criteria, "Criteria", solano_indicators)
apply_column_merges(wb, "Dashboard summary (Merged)", merge_indicator, "indicator", solano_indicators)
apply_column_merges(wb, "Dashboard summary (Merged)", merge_groups, "total_groups", solano_indicators)
apply_column_merges(wb, "Dashboard summary (Merged)", merge_compare, "compare_ca", solano_indicators)
apply_column_merges(wb, "Dashboard summary (Merged)", merge_n, "n", solano_indicators)
apply_column_merges(wb, "Dashboard summary (Merged)", merge_year, "reportingyear", solano_indicators)

# Auto-size columns for better readability
setColWidths(wb, "Dashboard summary (Merged)", cols = 1:(ncol(solano_indicators)-1), widths = "auto")

# Add formatting for easier reading
addFilter(wb, "Dashboard summary (Merged)", row = 1, cols = 1:(ncol(solano_indicators)-1))
freezePane(wb, "Dashboard summary (Merged)", firstRow = TRUE)

# Save workbook
saveWorkbook(wb, "Solano charter performance 2025.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
```
